statement.zh: 内陆粪便中出现海洋蛋白并与灌溉/玉米证据并存，支持区域内海岸—河谷互动，不等于已证明长途贸易路线图。
statement.en: Marine protein in inland coprolites alongside irrigation/maize evidence supports intra-regional coast–valley interaction, not a mapped long-distance trade system.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
